data.about: I am a Senior Software Engineer at Coinbase, the leading cryptocurrency platform that aims to create an open financial system for the world. In this role, I deliver technical value across various business units, such as Compliance, CX, Marketing, Finance, and Business Development, by creating scalable and secure solutions using serverless computing, Golang, Airflow, N8N and Workato.I have a strong background in Computer Science and Engineering, with a Bachelor's Degree from Bengal Institute Of Technology, where I won several hackathons and project activities. I am also certified in MuleSoft, a leading integration platform that I used extensively in my previous role as a Lead Software Engineer at Persistent Systems. There, I led a team of developers, received multiple awards, and helped clients with their Anypoint Platform utilization and discovery.Technology is my passion, and I love to explore new technologies and find insights on what works best for a given use case. I am an innovator and a critical thinker, always looking for ways to improve and optimize the systems and processes I work with. I am motivated by the challenges and opportunities that the cryptocurrency industry offers, and I am eager to contribute to Coinbase's mission and vision.

description.text:
Led the modernization of high-risk compliance workflows by building a secure, real-time in-app verification suite. Consolidated fragmented manual processes into a seamless digital experience for Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD).

Problem: 
Critical EDD checks relied on insecure, manual email threads, causing friction for high-net-worth customers and operational bottlenecks.

Solution: 
Engineered a secure, end-to-end verification platform integrated directly into the Coinbase app. Orchestrated complex data sync between Salesforce (for case management) and internal Go microservices.

Impact:
Risk & Compliance: Enforced strict, audit-ready verification flows for high-risk accounts, significantly reducing regulatory exposure.
Customer Experience: Eliminated email-based back-and-forth, enabling customers to securely upload documents and track status in real-time.
Operational Efficiency: Reduced case resolution times by 40% by automating document intake and validation.

Architected and deployed a centralized communications platform consolidating millions of customer interactions across Salesforce, internal notification services, and third-party channels. This system serves as the single source of truth for all client-facing communications at Coinbase.

Problem: 
Communication data was fragmented across siloed systems (Salesforce, SendGrid, Internal Services), creating blind spots for Support, Risk, and Legal teams during critical investigations.

Solution: 
Built a high-throughput ingestion pipeline using Kafka and Go to unify message history. Implemented GenAI/LLM-based summarization to instantly condense complex communication threads for compliance audits.

Impact:
Reduced Investigation Time: Cut manual review time by ~95% for Risk/Compliance teams via AI-driven summaries.
Operational Efficiency: Saved thousands of analyst hours monthly by providing a unified, searchable view of delivery status, open rates, and engagement.
Compliance & Audit: Enabled real-time traceability and reliable audit trails for Legal and CX teams, eliminating data fragmentation.

Architected a mission-critical platform to unify all institutional client data (Organizations, Entities, Products, Users) into a single golden source of truth, eliminating data fragmentation across legacy silos.

Problem: 
Institutional data was scattered across disparate legacy systems, leading to inconsistencies, slow onboarding, and heavy manual reconciliation.

Solution: 
Built a high-performance Go/gRPC data migration pipeline to consolidate and normalize millions of records. Leveraged Snowflake for complex data transformation and SQL for rigorous validation.

Impact:
Legacy Decommissioning: Successfully retired multiple legacy systems by ensuring 100% data fidelity in the new Organizations Service.
Data Integrity: Established a single source of truth for institutional clients, directly enabling faster product rollouts and accurate reporting.
Scalability: Designed the migration framework to handle massive datasets with high reliability and zero downtime during transition.

Architected a mission-critical Identity Verification Service (IDV) processing millions of onboarding verifications through a unified API gateway. Orchestrated real-time Know Your Customer (KYC) checks using multiple third-party vendors for maximum reliability and global coverage.

Problem: 
Onboarding friction and potential fraud vectors due to fragmented vendor integrations and manual verification steps.

Solution: 
Built a highly scalable Go/gRPC microservice to orchestrate parallel IDV/EDP checks. Implemented intelligent vendor routing to maximize approval rates and minimize cost.

Impact:
Accelerated Onboarding: Slashed customer verification times by 40%, directly boosting conversion rates.
Fraud Mitigation: Enforced rigorous, multi-factor ID proofing to strengthen platform security against synthetic identities.
Operational Scalability: Designed the system to handle peak sign-up volumes (e.g., bull runs) without latency degradation.

Architected and developed a mission-critical document translation service (DTS) enabling global operations and compliance by automating multilingual document processing at scale.

Problem: 
Manual translation delays were a major bottleneck for compliance and support teams handling global KYC documents.

Solution: 
Built a high-throughput, asynchronous microservice using Go and AWS SQS to ingest and translate diverse file formats. Leverage GenAI/LLM-based translation APIs for context-aware accuracy.

Impact:
Global Operations: Enabled seamless compliance reviews across non-English speaking markets, directly supporting international expansion.
Operational Efficiency: Automated the translation workflow, reducing document processing turnaround times from days to minutes.
Cost Optimization: Implemented smart routing to select the most cost-effective translation provider based on document type and complexity.

Engineered a real-time threat intelligence platform to monitor global cryptocurrency market events, safeguarding the exchange against volatility and security risks.

Problem: 
Manual screening of fragmented news sources (Twitter, Messari, LunarCrush) resulted in slow reaction times to critical market events and potential exploits.

Solution:
Built a high-throughput Publisher-Subscriber architecture to ingest social signals and market data. Leveraged Kafka to broadcast events to multiple downstream consumers, including an automated triage pipeline in ProcessUnity.

Impact:
Proactive Security: Enabled near real-time detection of market-moving news and security threats, significantly reducing reaction time.
Operational Efficiency: Automated the ingestion and routing of thousands of daily signals, allowing the Monitoring Team to focus solely on high-value triage.
Scalability: Designed a resilient ingestion layer capable of handling massive spikes in social sentiment data during high-volatility market cycles.

Architected and developed a high-performant, hybrid mobile application enabling insurance agents to calculate complex premium quotes instantly on both Android and iOS devices.

Problem: 
Legacy premium calculation tools were desktop-bound and slow, hindering agents' ability to close deals in the field.

Solution: 
Built a modern, offline-first mobile app using Ionic 5 and Capacitor. Implemented complex actuarial business logic in Angular to ensure calculation accuracy.

Core Responsibilities:
Mobile Architecture: Designed the hybrid app architecture to support seamless cross-platform deployment (iOS & Android) from a single codebase.
Business Logic Implementation: Engineered complex premium calculation engines in TypeScript, ensuring 100% adherence to actuarial formulas.
Performance Optimization: Optimized app rendering and state management to deliver native-like performance on mobile devices.
Team Collaboration: Partnered with Product Managers and QA to define requirements, track defects in Jira, and drive rapid feature iterations.

Impact:
Sales Velocity: Empowered field agents to generate accurate quotes in real-time, significantly reducing the sales cycle.
Code Reusability: Achieved >90% code reuse across Android and iOS platforms, slashing development and maintenance costs.
User Experience: Delivered a responsive, intuitive interface that simplified complex data entry for agents.

Architected a scalable API integration layer to unify data across multiple Lines of Business (LoB), serving as the backbone for the company's Machine Learning initiatives.

Problem: 
Critical claims and business data were locked in siloed legacy databases (Oracle, MS SQL), preventing the deployment of predictive ML models and slowing down claim adjustments.

Solution: 
Built a three-layered API topology (System, Process, Experience) using MuleSoft to aggregate and transform data. Delivered clean, normalized datasets to Machine Learning engines and real-time dashboards for Claim Adjusters.

Core Responsibilities:
API Architecture: Designed comprehensive RAML specifications and API contracts (Interface Definition), enforcing strict data schemas for downstream ML consumption.
Data Integration (ETL): Orchestrated complex data aggregation from heterogeneous sources (Oracle, MS SQL) using DataWeave transformation logic to feed algorithmic models.
Security & Governance: Applied rigorous API policies (OAuth, Client ID enforcement) via Anypoint API Manager to secure sensitive insurance data.
Quality Assurance: Implemented automated MUnit testing frameworks to ensure 100% data accuracy for decision-critical applications.

Impact:
Enabled AI/ML: Unlocked access to high-value internal data, directly enabling the deployment of predictive risk models.
Operational Visibility: Powered a real-time Claim Adjuster Dashboard by unifying data streams, significantly reducing claim decision latency.
System Decoupling: Abstraction of legacy databases via System APIs allowed for safer, independent maintenance of backend systems.

Architected and deployed a mission-critical automated data privacy solution to ensure immediate regulatory compliance following the Supreme Court's ruling on Aadhaar data usage by insurance providers.

Problem:
Millions of submitted insurance documents contained sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII/Aadhaar Numbers) that were now legally prohibited from being stored in plaintext. Manual redaction was impossible at scale.

Solution:
Built a high-performance Computer Vision pipeline using Python OpenCV and Tesseract OCR to automatically detect, extract, and permanently mask Aadhaar numbers from uploaded KYC documents in real-time.

Core Responsibilities:
Algorithm Development: Researched and benchmarked various cognitive computing techniques (e.g., Tesseract vs. Commercial APIs) to select the optimal model for accuracy vs. cost.
Image Processing Pipeline: Designed robust image preprocessing steps (binarization, skew correction) to maximize OCR accuracy on low-quality scanned documents.
Real-Time Feedback: Implemented a responsive Angular frontend with WebSockets to provide instant masking confirmation to compliance officers.

Impact:
Regulatory Compliance: Achieved 100% adherence to new Supreme Court mandates, avoiding potential legal penalties and business shutdown risks.
Data Security: Permanently redacted sensitive PII from millions of historical and incoming documents, significantly reducing the organization's data breach surface area.
Operational Scale: Automated the redaction process, eliminating the need for a manual compliance workforce of 50+ FTEs.

Architected an AI-powered textual analysis platform to automate the extraction of critical entities from unstructured adjuster notes, accelerating claim settlements.

Problem: 
Manual review of lengthy, unstructured claim notes was highly time-consuming, leading to delayed settlements and inconsistent data extraction across adjusters.

Solution: 
Built a comprehensive Natural Language Processing (NLP) pipeline using Python (SpaCy, NLTK) to automatically identify and extract key entities (Dates, Locations, Damages). Implemented an Active Learning loop where adjuster feedback continuously retrained the model.


Core Responsibilities:
Model Engineering: Developed and fine-tuned custom Named Entity Recognition (NER) models in SpaCy, establishing a domain-specific "Business Entity Dictionary" for higher accuracy.
Feedback/RLHF Pipeline: Designed the "Human-in-the-Loop" workflow, capturing adjuster modifications via an Angular dashboard to iteratively improve model performance (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback).
API Development: Built scalable REST APIs in Flask to handle PDF ingestion, OCR preprocessing, and real-time entity serving.
Tech Selection: Evaluated multiple NLP libraries (NLTK vs. SpaCy vs. Commercial APIs) to select the optimal balance of speed and accuracy for the specific domain.
